external_entities.name: colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague who signs in through the identity broker and uses applications.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.
external_entities.notes: The text does not state whether colleagues are employees, franchise colleagues, or both; franchise colleagues are modelled separately where explicitly distinguished.

external_entities.name: franchise colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague from a franchise store who uses the franchise identity provider to sign in through the broker.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them
external_entities.notes: The text does not state the physical or network location of franchise colleagues.

external_entities.name: HR system
external_entities.description: The system that supplies group membership changes to the identity broker overnight.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Group membership is not maintained there by hand — it comes from the HR system overnight.

external_entities.name: identity provider
external_entities.description: The identity provider controlled by the franchise stores that vouches for franchise colleagues.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them
external_entities.notes: The text does not state which colleagues this provider is allowed to vouch for.

external_entities.name: own device
external_entities.description: A colleague's own device used to sign in from home.
external_entities.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: Signs colleagues in, issues tokens, validates federated sign-ins, supplies public signing keys, and writes identity and audit data.
processes.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.
processes.notes: The broker signs tokens with a signing key, keeps colleague and group data in its directory, and writes sign-ins to an audit log.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application that uses the token's groups to authorize price changes and transaction voids.
processes.source_excerpt: The store admin console is one of those applications. It also runs on the corporate network.
processes.notes: The console does not check which store the colleague belongs to, so a store-manager token works against every store.

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: A store holding the signing key used by the identity broker.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The identity broker's directory containing colleagues and their group memberships.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: A log to which the identity broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has written down what the log records or whether it covers the franchise route.

data_flows.name: sign-in
data_flows.description: A colleague signs in to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are
data_flows.data_description: unknown

data_flows.name: issue token
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues a token containing the colleague's staff ID and groups.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Once the broker has signed a colleague in it issues them a token.
data_flows.data_description: The token carries the colleague's staff id and a list of the groups they are in.

data_flows.name: use console
data_flows.description: A colleague presents the token to the store admin console and performs authorized administrative actions.
data_flows.source_excerpt: If the token has the store-manager group in it, the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions.
data_flows.data_description: A token carrying the colleague's staff ID and group memberships; authorized actions include changing prices and voiding transactions.

data_flows.name: fetch public key
data_flows.description: The store admin console fetches the public half of the broker's signing key.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.
data_flows.data_description: The public half of the token-signing key.

data_flows.name: update membership
data_flows.description: The HR system supplies group membership and leaver changes to the identity broker overnight.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night
data_flows.data_description: Group membership changes and changes indicating that leavers stop being colleagues.

data_flows.name: write directory
data_flows.description: The identity broker maintains colleague and group membership data in its directory.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.
data_flows.data_description: Colleagues and the groups they are in.

data_flows.name: keep signing key
data_flows.description: The identity broker keeps its signing key in the key store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.
data_flows.data_description: The token-signing key.

data_flows.name: write sign-ins
data_flows.description: The identity broker writes sign-in events to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_flows.data_description: Sign-in records; the text does not specify what the records contain.

data_flows.name: vouch sign-in
data_flows.description: A franchise colleague signs in through the franchise identity provider.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them
data_flows.data_description: unknown

data_flows.name: vouch colleague
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider vouches for a franchise colleague and the broker accepts that as a sign-in.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in.
data_flows.notes: The text does not state which colleagues the identity provider is allowed to vouch for.
data_flows.data_description: A sign-in assertion for a franchise colleague.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network where the identity broker and store admin console run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: home
trust_boundaries.description: The home environment containing colleagues' own devices used to sign in.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home

trust_boundaries.name: franchise stores
trust_boundaries.description: The franchise-controlled environment associated with franchise colleagues and their own identity provider.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.

assumptions.assumption: The key store's contents are confidential because it holds the token-signing key.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the key store holds a signing key.

assumptions.assumption: The directory's contents are confidential because it holds colleagues and their group memberships.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the directory keeps colleagues and the groups they are in.

assumptions.assumption: The store admin console presents a web interface because the text names it as a console.
assumptions.basis: The process is explicitly named 'store admin console'; consoles are web interfaces under the interface-kind definition.
